notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content: Just a few small visual fixes. Nothing major has been changed

notes.title: Epic Games Account Link!
notes.content:
With this new patch comes the launch of the Epic Games Store version of Runbow! This patch here on steam will allow you to connect your Steam and Epic accounts so that you can play with your friends regardless of what digital distrobution platform the game is on!

You can enable and disable this in the Options screen!

notes.title: Discord channel for Runbow
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

We have opened a Discord channel for 13AM Games that you can use to talk to other Runbow players, in the hopes that it will make it easier to organize and find multiplayer rooms, as well as talk about our other games or chat with us, the devs. Hope to see you there!

https://discord.gg/zHj2jaW
